# Wrist Group appoints Robert Desai as Group CEO

October 14, 2026

Wrist Group today announces the appointment of Robert Desai as Group CEO, effective 2 November 2026.

Robert joins Wrist from V.Group, where he serves as CEO of V.Ships, and brings more than 20 years of international leadership experience across shipping, maritime services, logistics and offshore services.

Robert has a strong track record of driving profitable growth, strengthening customer relationships and improving operational performance across global businesses. His appointment supports Wrist’s continued development as a global leader in marine supply and logistics.

Will Hanenberg, Chairman of the Board of Wrist and Partner at J.F. Lehman & Company, said: 

> “We are very pleased to welcome Robert as Group CEO of Wrist. He brings a combination of deep maritime industry knowledge, strong commercial leadership and a proven ability to translate strategy into performance. Just as importantly, he understands the importance of staying close to customers, empowering strong local teams and building scalable global capabilities.

> Wrist has an exceptional market position, a truly global platform and significant opportunities ahead of us. We have made substantial progress in strengthening the organization, expanding our capabilities and advancing our strategic agenda. With Robert, Anders Skipper and Nicolas Ingram forming the Executive Management team, I am very excited about the leadership we now have in place and the potential to take Wrist through its next phase of profitable growth and development.” 

Robert Desai said:

> “I am very excited to join Wrist and to have the opportunity to lead a business with such a strong market position, global reach and long-standing customer relationships. Wrist has built an impressive platform, and I see significant potential to continue developing the business through deeper client engagement, operational excellence, digitalization and disciplined growth. 

> What particularly attracts me to Wrist is the combination of global strength and local entrepreneurship. Success in our industry ultimately depends on understanding customers, executing for them reliably every day and empowering capable people close to the business. I look forward to working with Anders, Nicolas, the wider leadership team and all our colleagues across Wrist to build on what has already been achieved and create the next chapter of the company’s development.” 

Robert’s appointment follows the leadership transition announced on 8 September 2026, when Jens Holger Nielsen stepped down as Group CEO and joined the Wrist Advisory Board. With Robert’s appointment, Wrist Group’s Executive Management will consist of Robert Desai as Group CEO, Anders Skipper as Group CFO and Nicolas Ingram as CEO of Wrist Ship Supply. 

## About Robert Desai 

Robert Desai is a Swedish national with more than 20 years of international experience across shipping, maritime logistics and offshore services. He currently serves as CEO of V.Ships within V.Group and has previously held executive leadership positions as CEO of V.Services and Group Chief Commercial Officer of V.Group, Chief Commercial Officer and Offshore Director of P&O Maritime Logistics, and Chief Commercial Officer of Topaz Energy & Marine.

Throughout his career, Robert has led global businesses through periods of growth, transformation and operational improvement and has worked extensively with customers, management teams, boards and active owners. His experience includes building commercially focused organizations, improving client retention, developing technology-enabled operating models and executing strategic transactions.

Press release | Jens Holger Nielsen, Anders Skipper, Group CEO

# Wrist Group Announces Leadership Transition

September 8, 2026

Wrist Group today announced that Jens Holger Nielsen will transition from his role as Group CEO to join the Wrist Advisory Board.

Jens Holger has served as Group CEO of Wrist since January 2020 and has led the Group through a significant period of development and growth. During his tenure, Wrist expanded its global footprint, including into Central and South America, completed a number of strategic acquisitions to increase scale and broaden its service offering, and launched Source2Sea, an independent digital marketplace serving the marine supply and logistics ecosystem.

 Will Hanenberg, Chairman of Wrist and Partner at J.F. Lehman & Company, Wrist’s majority shareholder, said:

> “On behalf of the Board, I would like to thank Jens Holger for his leadership and dedicated service over the past six years. He leaves the Group meaningfully larger, more global and better positioned than he found it, and we are pleased that Wrist will continue to draw on his experience and judgement through the Advisory Board. Anders and the broader management team have the full support of the Board and remain focused on serving our customers and executing Wrist’s strategic priorities.”

 Jens Holger Nielsen said:

> “It has been a privilege to lead Wrist over the past six years and to work alongside a capable and committed team backed by strong shareholders. Together we have grown the business into new markets and taken meaningful steps in the digital transformation of our industry. I am proud of what we have built together, and I am grateful to our employees, whose dedication to serving seafarers and customers is what sets Wrist apart, and to our customers and partners for their trust and support. The company is in a strong position, and this is the right moment for its next chapter of leadership and growth. I look forward to continuing to contribute to Wrist's success through the Advisory Board.”

Further information regarding the Group CEO role will be shared at the appropriate time.

‍ About Wrist ‍ Wrist Group is a global leader in marine supply and logistics, operating across 40 locations worldwide and serving more than 750 ports – delivering Expert Care to seafarers around the globe. The company is a pioneer in the digital transformation of the maritime supply and logistics industry, streamlining the marine supply chain and procurement for customers. Committed to responsibility, Wrist continuously develops innovative solutions and services that address the industry’s growing demand for efficiency, reliability, and long-term value creation.

Wrist Group is owned by J.F. Lehman &Company, a U.S. private equity firm.

Press release | Wrist appoints Nicolas Ingram as CEO of Wrist Ship Supply

# Wrist Group appoints Nicolas Ingram as CEO of Wrist Ship Supply

June 1, 2026

Effective 1 June 2026, Nicolas Ingram has joined Wrist Group as CEO of Wrist Ship Supply (WSS). In this role, he will lead the continued development of the business and support the delivery of the company’s ambitious expansion strategy, targeting excellent customer service and significant increases in revenue by the end of 2029 through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, and the execution of an advanced strategic agenda.

As CEO of Wrist Ship Supply, Nicolas Ingram will join the Global Management Team of Wrist. He will assume overall responsibility for the global Ship Supply organization, including its operational, commercial, transitional, and financial performance.

In this role, Nicolas Ingram will lead the strategic direction and day-to-day management of WSS, with a strong focus on enhancing the company’s global commercial and operational capabilities. He will also play a key role in advancing strategic initiatives, including the continued execution of the new WSS operating model and the next phase of digitizing the business in the Shared Way Forward program.

Nicolas Ingram brings more than 15 years of international leadership experience within B2B distribution, most recently as Managing Director for Central & Eastern Europe at Bunzl, a FTSE 100 listed global distribution company. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated a strong track record in delivering profitable growth, leading multi-country organizations, driving transformation initiatives, and executing acquisitions and integrations.

Will Hanenberg, Chairman of Wrist and Partner at J.F. Lehman & Company, owner of Wrist, says:

> “Wrist is a world-class platform, and the opportunity in front of us is substantial. Our focus now is on building on that foundation, expanding our reach, deepening our service offering, and continuing to put customers at the center of everything we do. Nicolas is a proven leader in B2B distribution and the right person to take Wrist to the next level. I have every confidence in him, and I’m excited about what this team will build.”

On joining Wrist, Nicolas Ingram comments: 

> "I’m truly excited to join Wrist, a company executing an ambitious, industry-defining strategy. I’m eager to drive further global growth and work closely with my new colleagues and customers across our worldwide locations."

‍ About Wrist

Wrist is a global leader in marine supply and logistics, operating across 40 locations worldwide and serving more than 750 ports to deliver Expert Care to seafarers around the globe.

The company is at the forefront of the digital transformation of the maritime supply and logistics industry, helping customers streamline procurement and marine supply chain operations. Committed to responsibility, Wrist continuously develops innovative solutions and services that address the industry’s growing demand for efficiency, reliability, and long-term value creation.

Wrist Group is owned by J.F. Lehman & Company, a U.S. private equity firm.
